art_direction: 海洋行星的弧形地平线上升起暖日，云海与城市无关，视角宏大而安静。
composition: one original focal subject, centered and readable within a circular avatar crop
creative_direction: View an ocean planet from low orbit at sunrise, with its curved horizon crossing the lower half of the frame. A warm sun emerges behind the atmosphere near the center, casting a narrow luminous edge along blue clouds and dark water. Show several large cloud systems with smaller wisps within them, avoiding visible cities or continents that distract from the curve. Deep space remains open above. Keep the sunrise controlled rather than overexposed, using layered atmospheric color and soft reflections to build depth. Create a square 1024x1024 avatar with a clear central silhouette that remains legible at thumbnail size. Use an original text-only composition, without lettering, logos, signatures, or watermarks.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
